sections.markdown:
# BMRI.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp5,670.0 against Rp3,610.0 (expected total return 70.8%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- FY2026E credit cost is held at the 9M26 consolidated 0.63% on the strength of a BANK-ONLY October print (F72 0.55%). The consolidated ex-BSI series in S2 p11 accelerated through the year (1Q26 0.58, 1H26 0.61, 9M26 0.63)
- Every new fact (F64-F78) is bank-only; every model input is consolidated ex-BSI. The report never bridges the two perimeters — Oct bank-only loans Rp1,635tn against FY2026E consolidated Rp1,740tn, bank-only CoC 0.55% aga
- Section 3 says the base sits 'just under four percent below the annualised 9M26 run-rate' and, two sentences later, that 'the fourth quarter has to deliver its normal seasonal step-up'. The model's own arithmetic gives F

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
